components.label: Description
components.quote: MNEXSPIKE (COVID-19 Vaccine, mRNA) is a sterile white to off-white injectable suspension for intramuscular use.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Each 0.2 mL dose of MNEXSPIKE (2026-2027 Formula) contains 10 mcg nucleoside-modified messenger RNA (mRNA) encoding the N-terminal domain (NTD) and receptor-binding domain (RBD) of the spike glycoprotein (S) of the SARS-CoV-2 JN.1-descendent variant XFG. Each dose also contains the following ingredients: a total lipid content of 0.2 mg (SM-102, polyethylene glycol [PEG] 2000 dimyristoyl glycerol [DMG], cholesterol, and 1,2-distearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine [DSPC]), 0.09 mg tromethamine, 0.51 mg tromethamine hydrochloride, and 17 mg sucrose.

allergens.quote: The rubber tip cap and plunger used for the single-dose syringes are not made with natural rubber latex.

Each dose also contains the following ingredients: a total lipid content of 0.2 mg (SM-102, polyethylene glycol [PEG] 2000 dimyristoyl glycerol [DMG], cholesterol, and 1,2-distearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine [DSPC]), 0.09 mg tromethamine, 0.51 mg tromethamine hydrochloride, and 17 mg sucrose.
allergens.note: 脂質奈米顆粒含 PEG 2000-DMG（非 polysorbate）

allergens.quote: MNEXSPIKE does not contain a preservative.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Do not administer MNEXSPIKE to individuals with a known history of severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to any component of MNEXSPIKE [see Description (11)] or to individuals who had a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) following a previous dose of SPIKEVAX (COVID-19 Vaccine, mRNA) or any Moderna COVID-19 vaccine authorized for emergency use.

dismissed.peg_polysorbate: 全文掃描『polyethylene glycol』另在 8.1 Pregnancy 動物試驗段（p.18，大鼠試驗劑型）出現，與 p.19 人用配方描述內容相同（同一 PEG 2000-DMG 脂質），非額外成分，已在正式成分句判讀為有並附 p.19 引句
dismissed.egg: 全文掃描『embryo』3 個命中皆為 p.18 8.1 Pregnancy 段落（大鼠發育毒理學研究『embryo/fetus』與段落標題『Embryo/Fetal Risk』），與雞蛋成分無關
